description_en: Unbinds a 700 number from its binding relationship
name: UnbindSubs700

parameters.help_en:
The key of the China 700 number pool.

You can obtain the number pool key from the China 700 Number Pool Management (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool) page in the China 700 Number Privacy Protection console
parameters.help_zh:
号码池Key。

在号码隐私保护控制台，号码池管理 (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool)页面获取号码池Key
parameters.name: pool_key

parameters.help_en: The intermediate number X. If the service user does not specify an X number, the application platform assigns a number from the number pool as the X number
parameters.help_zh: 中间号X。业务使用方未指定X号码时，由应用平台从号码池中指定一个号码作为X号码
parameters.name: telx

parameters.help_en: The order ID. This parameter is required in practice. Encrypt the order ID before submission because it is reported to the regulatory platform
parameters.help_zh: 订单 ID(实际上必填， 建议客户进行订单号加密，用于报送监管平台)
parameters.name: order_id

parameters.help_en: Optional. The Industrial Internet identifier code, which has a one-to-one relationship with OrderId. The code supports delimiter characters such as "." and "/" to separate code segments. The code must not contain nonprinting characters such as spaces or line feeds. This parameter is required when the service user generates the Industrial Internet identifier code independently
parameters.help_zh:
可选工业互联网标识编码，与OrderID保持一一对应关系。编码支持“.”、“/”等字符分割编码域，编码中不得含有不可显示类字符，如空格符、换行符等。
当业务使用方自行生成工业互联网标识编码时，该字段必选
parameters.name: industrial_id
